zh: 一个子串里每个字母都出现偶数次，等价于它两端的前缀里，每个字母出现次数的奇偶性完全相同。
把 26 个字母的奇偶性压成一个 26 位掩码，每读一个字符就翻转对应位。两个位置的前缀掩码相同，中间那一段就是合法子串；固定右端点时，左端越早越长。
用哈希表记录每种掩码第一次出现的位置，空前缀的掩码 0 记为位置 −1。扫描到 i 时更新掩码，若它已出现过就用 i − 最早位置更新答案，否则记下 i。全程没有合法非空子串时答案为 0。
en: Every letter occurs an even number of times in a substring exactly when the two prefixes bounding it have the same parity for every letter.

Pack the parities of the 26 letters into a 26-bit mask and flip one bit per character. Two positions with the same prefix mask enclose a valid substring, and for a fixed right end, the earliest matching left end gives the longest one.

Store the first position where each mask appears in a hash map, with mask 0 of the empty prefix at position -1. At index i update the mask; if it has been seen, update the answer with i minus that earliest position, otherwise record i. If no non-empty valid substring exists the answer stays 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Encode the parity of the occurrences of the 26 letters as a bitmask, and record the earliest position where each state appears.

## Proof of correctness

When two prefix parity masks are equal, every letter occurs an even number of times between them; for a fixed right end, choosing the earliest position gives the longest substring. Scanning all prefixes and taking the maximum length gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(min(n, 2^26)) space.
